sources.description: The Denver Broncos have somehow made it to 2-2. If you listen to the doomsayers, we have a terrible offense, a terrible defense, AND a QB who needs to be replaced. The combined record of the Bronco’s four opponents is 13-3 (2x 4-0, 3-1, and 2-2). Both losses were on the road. Both wins were […]
